sections.note: rc3, sitewide footer chrome, proposed rule

proposed_rules.trigger: A text node at the very top of the tree (rc1) whose content is a raw JS boot snippet, e.g. starting with document.addEventListener("DOM...
proposed_rules.decision: Exclude entirely from block inventory; source-leak artifact analogous to leaked-css-text-node but for JS.
proposed_rules.rationale: Recurs identically at rc1 on every captured page in this batch; boilerplate script text rendered visibly due to a source bug, never content.

proposed_rules.trigger: A [region] node containing FAQ answer text appears a second time as a sibling outside the main content flow (after the footer), duplicating text already nested under an accordion item.
proposed_rules.decision: Treat as a duplicate of the nested accordion answer already captured in the FAQ block; do not add as separate content.
proposed_rules.rationale: The page-tree capture promotes elements rendered outside their DOM parent (absolutely-positioned accordion panels), duplicating content already represented.

provenance.evidence: C182 rc4 duplicates rc2c8c2c11 answer text

proposed_rules.trigger: A trailing rc3 zone with fixed text 'The best no-code platform for...' plus a pipe-separated link row, identical across pages.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as a sitewide footer fragment, not page content; exclude from per-page block inventory.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical structure/text recurs at the same position on every page in this batch, indicating global template chrome.

proposed_rules.trigger: A short 'Trusted by hundreds of healthcare teams...' statement paired with a client/partner logo row inside the hero.
proposed_rules.decision: Emit as its own logos-style block instance rather than folding into a generic hero CTA. Rejected alternatives: (a) treat the empty logo container as decorative noise since it renders with no text, (b) merge into a single hero block with the CTA buttons.
proposed_rules.rationale: Recurs across health-vertical hero zones as a trust element distinct from CTA buttons; the logo container itself renders empty in this capture (likely images loaded outside text extraction) but the text framing confirms intent.

provenance.evidence: C182 rc2c1c3 'Trusted by hundreds of healthc...' + empty rc2c1c3c2 1186x76 container

proposed_rules.trigger: A [4x1] grid whose first row is a bold header row (bg:color) and subsequent rows compare pricing scenarios (e.g. 'Scenario / Per-User Platforms / Sales-based Platforms / Knack') across N usage scenarios.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as a dedicated pricing-table block (header row + N data rows) rather than the generic repeating-cards block, since it is tabular pricing data, not visual cards. Rejected alternative: emit as a plain markdown table in default-content, losing the block's own styling/behavior.
proposed_rules.rationale: The header-row + data-row shape is structurally a comparison table, not a card grid; a dedicated block name better signals its authoring semantics to content editors.

provenance.evidence: C182 rc2c4c2 rows c1 (bg:color header) through c4 (scenario data)

notes: Operations-management page-5 variant adds a pricing-comparison table and a single testimonial quote not seen in the other page-5 clusters in this batch; otherwise follows the standard hero/features/FAQ pattern.
